sources.title: Four killed in protests over Kenya fuel price hikes as strike strands commuters
sources.excerpt: roads into the capital Nairobi were blocked by striking transport operators and scattered groups of protesters
sources.provenance: Reuters, directly opened; reports strike and protests over fuel-price increases. The four deaths and more than 30 injuries are attributed to the interior minister; reporting also describes road blockages and police use of tear gas.

sources.title: Kenya’s capital hit by protests as fuel prices spark transport strike
sources.excerpt: a nationwide public transport strike kicked off to protest record fuel prices
sources.provenance: Associated Press search result; reports four deaths and over 30 injuries during the same event.

provisional_leads.assessment: Strong same-day Reuters coverage, with AP corroboration, of a national transport strike alongside protests over fuel costs.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: Reported fatality and injury totals are source-attributed; precise protester counts and the extent of locality-level participation are not established here.

provisional_leads.event_type: local protest against proposed quarantine facility
provisional_leads.actors: Local protesters and organizer Patrick Wahome; police at crowd-control scene
locations: Near Laikipia airbase, Nanyuki, Laikipia County

sources.title: Man shot dead during protest against proposed US Ebola quarantine facility in Kenya
sources.excerpt: Dozens of people had gathered near Laikipia airbase
sources.provenance: The Guardian, directly opened; page timestamp June 9, 2026. It reports a demonstration near the proposed site, a fatal shooting, arrests and tear gas. The fatality claim is attributed to organizer and reporting witnesses; police spokesperson said he lacked information.

provisional_leads.assessment: Date-specific public protest lead against the proposed facility, reported with a fatal shooting, dispersal and arrests.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: The newspaper reports allegations, statements and observations from different named sources; the available article does not settle the shooting circumstances.
